_note: The economy (docs/ECONOMY.md). Day jobs: three offered at a new game, each with a grade range rolled per game (grade_roll picks one). yields = material id: [min, max] units per day when you take 'a little'. Numbers are first guesses: tune here.

hospital.name: Hospital orderly
hospital.plus: Medical supplies, and field dressings are unlocked from day one.
hospital.minus: Night shifts: some nights you only get one action.

card.title: HOSPITAL
costs: Night shifts: 1 in 3 nights, one action

steel.name: Steel mill hand
steel.plus: Metal stock, and the mill's old drill press goes home with you (the gun bench works better).
steel.minus: The floor is watched: suspicion builds faster.

textile.name: Textile mill weaver
textile.plus: Cloth and webbing, and a cast-off sewing machine (rigs come out better).

lines.warn: The foreman counted the stock twice today. He looked at you while he did it.
lines.audit: AUDIT. They searched the lockers. You lost what you took today, and your name is on a list.
lines.fired: FIRED. Security walked you out. Your access is gone, and someone made a call.
